text: 市场全天低开低走，三大指数放量下挫。电力股逆势走强，桂冠电力、乐山电力、华银电力等涨停。金融股盘中拉升，湘财股份涨停。下跌方面，半导体芯片股大幅下挫，兆易创新、德明利、通富微电等多股跌停；算力硬件股集体下挫，天孚通信、中际旭创、新易盛均跌超10%。个股呈现普跌态势，沪深京三市近5000股飘绿，今日成交2.67万亿。截止收盘沪指跌3.05%，深成指跌5.4%，创业板指跌7.15%。
text_en: The market opened low and moved lower throughout the day, with the three major indices declining sharply on increased volume. Power stocks bucked the trend to strengthen, with Guiguan Electric Power, Leshan Electric Power, and Huayin Electric Power hitting the daily limit up. Financial stocks staged an intraday rally, with Xiangcai Securities hitting the daily limit up. On the downside, semiconductor chip stocks plunged sharply, with multiple stocks like GigaDevice, Demone Group, and Tongfu Microelectronics hitting the daily limit down; computing hardware stocks collectively fell, with TFC Optical Communication, Zhongji Innolight, and Eoptolink Technology all falling over 10%. Individual stocks experienced widespread declines, with nearly 5,000 stocks in the Shanghai, Shenzhen, and Beijing stock markets turning red. Today's total turnover was RMB 2.67 trillion. By the close, the Shanghai Composite Index fell 3.05%, the Shenzhen Component Index fell 5.4%, and the ChiNext Index fell 7.15%.
